theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 14 群

items.colloc: have a brief discussion 簡短討論 | have a further discussion 進一步討論
items.distinct: hold a meeting 正式會議 | engage in a conversation 對話交流
ex: The department heads will have a discussion regarding the budget.
部門主管將針對預算進行討論。
We need to have a discussion about the new marketing strategy.
我們需要商討一下新的行銷策略。
After having a discussion, the team reached a consensus.
經過討論後，團隊達成了一致意見。

items.colloc: change a flat tire 更換爆胎 | end up with a flat tire 遭遇爆胎
items.distinct: have a blowout 輪胎爆裂 | be out of gas 沒油
ex: I was late because I had a flat tire on the way.
我遲到了，因為路上輪胎爆了。
Drivers should check their pressure to avoid having a flat tire.
駕駛應檢查胎壓以避免發生爆胎。
She had a flat tire while driving to the client meeting.
她在開車去客戶會議的途中遇到了爆胎。

items.colloc: have full control over 完全掌控 | have limited control over 有限控制
items.distinct: be in control of 負責管理 | lose control of 失去對...的控制
ex: Management must have control over all project expenditures.
管理層必須對所有專案支出有控制權。
Do you have control over the production timeline?
你對生產時程有控制權嗎？
He does not have control over the current market fluctuations.
他無法掌控目前的市場波動。

items.colloc: have every reason to do 完全有理由做 | have no reason to do 沒有理由做
items.distinct: have a reason for 對...有理由 | be reasonable 講道理的
ex: We have reason to believe that the profit will increase.
我們有理由相信利潤將會增加。
The board has reason to do an audit of the accounts.
董事會有理由對帳目進行審計。
Employees have reason to expect a year-end bonus this term.
員工有理由期待本期的年終獎金。

items.colloc: prevent heart disease 預防心臟病 | risk of heart disease 心臟病風險
items.distinct: cardiac arrest 心臟驟停 | stroke 中風
ex: Regular exercise helps to lower the risk of heart disease.
規律運動有助於降低患心臟病的風險。
The company offers wellness programs to prevent heart disease.
公司提供健康計畫以預防心臟病。
High stress levels are linked to an increased risk of heart disease.
高壓力水準與增加的心臟病風險有關。

items.colloc: in an attempt to improve 為了改善 | in an attempt to resolve 試圖解決
items.distinct: in a bid to 為爭取...而 | with the aim of 以...為目標
ex: The firm cut costs in an attempt to boost earnings.
該公司為了提高獲利而削減成本。
They launched the product in an attempt to capture market share.
他們推出產品是為了試圖搶佔市場份額。
She worked overtime in an attempt to finish the report early.
她加班是為了試圖早點完成報告。

items.colloc: reach a conclusion 得出結論 | draw a conclusion 下結論
items.distinct: in summary 簡而言之 | to sum up 總而言之
ex: In conclusion, this investment will yield long-term benefits.
總之，這項投資將產生長期效益。
The report states, in conclusion, that the merger is beneficial.
報告在結論中指出，合併是有益的。
In conclusion, we must prioritize customer satisfaction above all.
總之，我們必須將客戶滿意度放在首位。

items.colloc: available in print 有印刷版 | be in print 仍在發行
items.distinct: out of print 絕版 | online version 網路版本
ex: The article is expected to be in print by next week.
該文章預計下週會以印刷版發行。
Many classic books are no longer available in print.
許多經典書籍已不再印刷出版。
You can find the updated policy in print at the reception.
你可以在櫃檯找到列印出來的最新政策。

items.colloc: vote in support of 投票支持 | speak in support of 發言支持
items.distinct: in favor of 贊同 | in opposition to 反對
ex: The CEO spoke in support of the new sustainability initiative.
執行長發言支持新的永續發展計畫。
Many shareholders are in support of the proposed acquisition.
許多股東都支持這項收購提議。
Evidence was presented in support of the current safety regulations.
證據被提出以支持目前的安全性規定。

items.colloc: in the event of delay 若發生延誤 | in the event of failure 若失敗
items.distinct: in case of 萬一 | in the event that 若...情況發生
ex: In the event of an emergency, please use the fire exit.
若發生緊急情況，請使用安全出口。
Staff will be notified in the event of a system shutdown.
若發生系統關閉，員工將會收到通知。
Please contact us in the event of any discrepancies in billing.
若帳單出現任何不符，請與我們聯繫。

items.colloc: manage the finance of 管理...的財務 | oversee the finance of 監督...的資金
items.distinct: in the field of 在...領域 | regarding the finance of 關於...的財務
ex: We need to be transparent in the finance of this venture.
我們在這次創投的財務上必須保持透明。
He plays a key role in the finance of large-scale projects.
他在大型專案的財務方面扮演關鍵角色。
Significant changes occurred in the finance of the public sector.
公共部門的財務方面發生了重大變革。

items.colloc: in the middle of a meeting 開會中 | in the middle of a process 過程中
items.distinct: at the center of 在中心點 | during the time of 在...期間
ex: I am currently in the middle of a very important negotiation.
我目前正忙於一場非常重要的談判。
They arrived while we were in the middle of a presentation.
我們正進行簡報時他們抵達了。
We are in the middle of upgrading our computer software systems.
我們正處於升級電腦軟體系統的過程中。

items.colloc: knock off early 早退 | knock off work 下班
items.distinct: clock off 打卡下班 | finish up 完成工作
ex: Let us knock off for the day and resume tomorrow morning.
我們今天先下班，明天早上再繼續吧。
Most employees knock off work at exactly five o'clock.
大多數員工準時五點下班。
The company decided to knock off ten percent for early payment.
公司決定針對提前付款提供百分之十的折扣。

items.colloc: left over food 剩菜 | money left over 剩餘資金
items.distinct: carry over 結轉 | surplus 盈餘
ex: There was little budget left over after the event expenses.
活動開銷後剩下的預算不多了。
Any parts left over should be returned to the warehouse.
任何剩下的零件都應歸還到倉庫。
She distributed the left over supplies to the regional offices.
她將剩餘的物資分發給各個區域辦公室。

items.colloc: link data together 連結資料 | link departments together 聯繫各部門
items.distinct: connect with 與...連結 | join together 合併
ex: The new software helps to link the databases together efficiently.
這套新軟體有助於有效地連結各資料庫。
We need to link our marketing efforts together for consistency.
為了保持一致性，我們需要將行銷工作連結起來。
The project will link together various regional branch offices.
該專案將連結各地的區域分公司。

items.colloc: make a logical conclusion 作出合乎邏輯的結論 | fail to make a conclusion 未能得出結論
items.distinct: come to a conclusion 得出結論 | draw a conclusion 歸納結論
ex: It is too early to make a conclusion about the survey results.
現在就針對調查結果下結論還太早。
The committee will make a conclusion after reviewing the evidence.
委員會在審閱證據後將會作出結論。
He refused to make a conclusion without further market data.
在沒有進一步市場數據的情況下，他拒絕下結論。

items.colloc: make a difficult decision 做艱難決定 | make a final decision 做最後決定
items.distinct: reach a decision 達成決議 | take a decision 採取行動(較不常用)
ex: Management needs to make a decision regarding the contract renewal.
管理層需要針對合約續簽做出決定。
We must make a decision before the end of the business day.
我們必須在下班前做出決定。
It is often hard to make a decision under such pressure.
在這種壓力下做出決定往往很困難。

items.colloc: make a cash deposit 現金存款 | make a security deposit 繳交保證金
items.distinct: open an account 開戶 | withdraw money 提款
ex: You need to make a deposit before the lease agreement starts.
在租約開始前，你需要支付一筆押金。
He went to the bank to make a deposit this morning.
他今天早上去了銀行存款。
The client will make a deposit to secure the shipping space.
客戶將支付一筆訂金以預留艙位。

items.colloc: make a final change to 修改最後稿件 | require a final change 需要最後調整
items.distinct: make an adjustment 進行調整 | finalize a document 將文件定稿
ex: Please make a final change to the layout before printing.
請在列印前對版面進行最後的修改。
The editor will make a final change to the manuscript today.
編輯今天會對手稿進行最後的修正。
We are ready to submit once we make a final change.
一旦我們完成最後的修改，就可以提交了。

items.colloc: make it clear 說明清楚 | make one's position clear 表明立場
items.distinct: clarify 澄清 | explain 解釋
ex: The manager wanted to make clear the goals for this quarter.
經理想要把本季的目標說明清楚。
She made clear that all deadlines must be strictly followed.
她明確表示所有截止期限都必須嚴格遵守。
Please make clear your requirements in the initial email.
請在第一封郵件中把你的需求講清楚。
